# The Biology Corner

> > Comprehensive biology teaching resource providing worksheets, dissection guides, case studies, and lab activities aligned with NGSS and AP Biology standards.

Created by educator Shannan Muskopf, The Biology Corner offers ready-to-use materials for high school and middle school biology teachers, including hands-on investigations, genetics problems, anatomy labs, and scientific method activities that support Next Generation Science Standards.

## Key Topics

- AP Biology
- Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS)
- High School Biology
- Scientific Method
- Genetics and Heredity (HS-LS3-1)
- Cell Structure and Function (HS-LS1-1, HS-LS1-2)
- Anatomy and Dissection Labs
- Natural Selection and Evolution
- Case Studies
- Biology Worksheets
- Ecology
- Data Analysis
- Middle School Science
- Skeletal System
- DNA and Mutations

## Anatomy and Dissection Labs

- [Sheep Brain Dissection Guide](https://www.biologycorner.com/2016/06/01/sheep-brain-dissection-guide): Lab guide for sheep brain dissection covering external and internal anatomy
- [Investigation: Rat Dissection](https://www.biologycorner.com/2016/12/24/investigation-rat-dissection): AP Biology rat dissection lab covering muscles, bones, and organs
- [Frog Dissection Coloring](https://www.biologycorner.com/2017/02/03/frog-anatomy-coloring-worksheet): Frog anatomy coloring worksheet with organ system identification
- [External Anatomy of the Grasshopper](https://www.biologycorner.com/2016/07/18/external-anatomy-of-the-grasshopper): Grasshopper dissection guide focusing on external anatomy and labeling
- [The Anatomy of a Bony Fish](https://www.biologycorner.com/2017/01/05/the-anatomy-of-a-bony-fish): Fish anatomy coloring worksheet with labeling and fin identification
- [Compare Bones of a Human and Chimpanzee Skeleton](https://www.biologycorner.com/2017/04/17/compare-a-human-and-chimpanzee-skeleton): Evolution worksheet comparing human and chimp skeletons for bipedalism

## Genetics and Molecular Biology

- [Practice Problems: Genetics and Blood Types](https://www.biologycorner.com/2017/05/07/genetics-and-blood-types): ABO blood type genetics practice with Punnett squares and inheritance
- [DNA Mutation Activity](https://www.biologycorner.com/2017/06/15/dna-mutation-activity): Simulation activity showing frameshift, point, and silent mutations
- [What is a Map Unit Anyway?](https://www.biologycorner.com/2016/03/30/what-is-a-map-unit-anyway): Explains chromosome mapping and map units based on crossover frequency

## Cell Biology and Cellular Processes

- [Mitosis in an Onion Cell](https://www.biologycorner.com/2016/06/12/mitosis-in-an-onion-cell): Worksheet for onion root tip mitosis lab showing cell division phases
- [Color a Typical Prokaryote Cell](https://www.biologycorner.com/2017/05/29/color-a-typical-prokaryote-cell): Bacteria cell coloring worksheet comparing prokaryotes and eukaryotes

## Evolution and Ecology

- [Investigation: What Factors Influence Evolution](https://www.biologycorner.com/2016/06/29/investigation-what-factors-influence-evolution): Evolution simulation exploring mutation and selection strength effects
- [Case Study - Investigation of Animal Behavior](https://www.biologycorner.com/2016/05/09/case-study-investigation-of-animal-behavior): AP Biology lab on animal behavior with pillbugs and chi-square analysis

## Scientific Method and Investigations

- [Investigation: Plop Plop Fizz Fizz](https://www.biologycorner.com/2016/06/30/investigation-plop-plop-fizz-fizz): Scientific method lab using Alka-Seltzer dissolution rate experiments
- [Investigation: How Much Water Is In a Plant?](https://www.biologycorner.com/2016/07/05/investigation-how-much-water-is-in-a-plant): Lab comparing water content in plant roots, fruits, and leaves
- [Investigation: Stride Length and Bone Lengths](https://www.biologycorner.com/2017/07/18/investigation-stride-length-and-bone-lengths): Forensic science lab using bone measurements to predict height
- [Practice Multiple Choice Quiz: The Science of Biology](https://www.biologycorner.com/2016/08/11/qz-the-science-of-biology): Multiple choice quiz on scientific method and hypothesis testing

## Teaching Resources and Strategies

- [The Biology Corner - Resources for Teachers](https://www.biologycorner.com): Homepage for biology teacher resources including worksheets and labs
- [Learn Biology with Case Studies at HHMI Biointeractive](https://www.biologycorner.com/2016/12/28/hhmi-and-case-studies): Overview of HHMI Biointeractive case studies and educational resources
- [How to Create Your Classroom Seating Chart](https://www.biologycorner.com/2014/08/06/seating-chart): Teaching strategies for assigning classroom seats on the first day
